STEP 1 - Vessel type: The food sits on a white plate with a flat centre and a raised rim band, no curved inner wall visible. Flat plate, square shape.

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Square plates are typically 20-30 cm. This one looks medium, around 24 cm across.
b) Reference: the olives are about 2.2 cm. Roughly 10 olive lengths span the plate's width of about 22 cm, which fits the 20-30 cm range. Reconciled width: 24 cm (square, area about 576 cm²).

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Olives: I count about 12 visible, with a few partly hidden. Total ~13 olives x 4 g = 52 g. Kcal ~ 115 per 100 g, so about 60 kcal.
- Cheese (grated/shaved Parmesan-style, on the lower left): footprint about 15% of plate area (~86 cm²), average thickness ~0.5 cm (a flat layer of shavings). Volume ~43 ml x 1.0 = ~45 g. Kcal ~390 per 100 g, so about 175 kcal.
- Baked dish (cheese-topped fish or chicken fillet, centre): footprint about 18% (~104 cm²), thickness about 1.5 cm (a mound about half its peak of ~3 cm). Volume ~156 ml x 1.0 = ~150 g. Kcal ~200 per 100 g (cheese-topped baked protein), about 300 kcal.
- Rice (brown/mixed grain, right side and under the protein): footprint about 20% (~115 cm²), thickness about 1 cm average. Volume ~115 ml x 0.8 = ~90 g. Kcal ~120 per 100 g, about 110 kcal.
- Cooked greens (spinach, centre right): footprint about 5% (~29 cm²), thickness about 0.8 cm. Volume ~23 ml x 0.6 = ~14 g. Kcal ~25 per 100 g, about 4 kcal.
- Meat pieces mixed with the rice (right side): footprint about 5% (~29 cm²), thickness about 0.8 cm. Volume ~23 ml x 1.0 = ~23 g. Kcal ~200 per 100 g, about 46 kcal.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: Rice runs under the baked dish and the meat, which I've already counted as a base layer. Total is a modest plated meal, not a heaped one, so no large extra mass is added.

STEP 5 - Totals: about 345 g, about 760 kcal.
